canonical_encoding.name: F06WH_OWNER_STATE_V2
canonical_encoding.rule: UTF-8 canonical JSON, keys sorted lexicographically, separators comma/colon, finite numbers only; every *_u32_repeat [count,word] descriptor MUST first expand to the complete indexed *_u32_words array; SHA-256 is over expanded bytes, never compact descriptor JSON
canonical_encoding.whole_material_shape: JSON object mapping each of the 13 owner names directly to its expanded cold value; wrapper schema/owners metadata is excluded
canonical_encoding.failure_comparison: compare every owner canonical digest before and after; only lifecycle phase/failed/failure_stage may change on fatal failure

meter_state.frontend_oar: F06OC canonical callback/cache/target/gain-row/record state; distinct from main frontend
meter_state.k_filter: state[6][2][4] F32 plus six mantissa F32 and six exponent I32 accumulators
meter_state.true_peak: fir_state[6][4628] F32 plus programme_true_max[6] and programme_sample_max[6] F32

main_none_drc_state.ordinary_input_history: history[6][1280] F32 cold +0; delayed exactly once
main_none_drc_state.secondary: forward_history[5][128] F32, inverse_carry[5][128] F32, frame_index U64
main_none_drc_state.scheduler: line/rf dynamics{level F32,hold U16,log_gain F32}; line/rf limiter{gain F32,hold U16}; peak_logs[6] F32; generation U64
main_none_drc_state.metadata_override_fifo: four zero logical records, metadata_delay=3072, append_slot=3, frames_processed U64
main_none_drc_state.programme_dialnorm: immutable U5 from finalized selected loudness

ownership_rules: meter state never aliases main audio or main codec state
primary history, secondary forward history and inverse carry are three distinct state families
integrated and ungated consume the same ordered energy pairs but never share state
true-peak final scalar does not replace none-DRC per-source peak_inputs
programme measurement is committed once before main source0
reset: reset reconstructs every owner to its COLD-STATE-IDENTITIES.json value, clears frozen measurement/digest, sets phase METER and source/callback generations0; no partial reset is valid
